params.message:
Version 4 of the log: key-1 moves onto a hardware token

key-1 was a file on the MacBook; a lost laptop meant a lost signing key. Its new key was made
on token A (39780281, slot 9E, PIN once and a touch per signature) and replaces the file key
in version 4, signed by the next key on token A; the fresh next key is on token B (39780275,
slot 9E) with the spare committed beside it. Everything the file key signed before version 4
still verifies through the log's history. The trust page says so.
